headline: Alphabet shares drop 13% as AI earnings results spark market sell-off
summary: Alphabet shares fell 13% following the release of its latest earnings, contributing to a $500 billion market wipeout. The results reignited investor concerns regarding the company's artificial intelligence strategy.
why: Alphabet is the parent company of Google and a major player in the global AI and cloud computing sectors. Significant volatility in its stock often impacts broader technology indices like the Nasdaq.

impacts.name: Nasdaq
impacts.why: Heavy weighting of Alphabet in the index drives broader market declines when the stock falls.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Weak earnings from a sector leader often dampen investor sentiment across the tech industry.

why_moved: The sharp decline in Alphabet's share price triggered a broader sell-off in the Nasdaq, as investors reacted negatively to the company's AI-related performance metrics.
